rungs.name: in-sample
rungs.guarantee: none: threshold chosen on the same receipts it is scored on
rungs.note: optimistic by construction, shown for contrast

rungs.name: fit-val split
rungs.guarantee: expected selective risk at most alpha, on average over splits, not a certificate

rungs.name: LTT field-iid
rungs.guarantee: field error at most alpha with probability 0.9, if fields were independent
rungs.note: no threshold meets the bound, coverage is zero

rungs.name: LTT cluster-corrected
rungs.guarantee: as above, sample size shrunk by the measured design effect
rungs.note: no threshold meets the bound, coverage is zero

rungs.name: LTT doc-iid
rungs.guarantee: share of passed receipts with any wrong field at most alpha, with probability 0.9
rungs.note: no threshold meets the bound, coverage is zero
